Tissue Examination Report: Specimen : A) SPECIMEN labeled right chest, Skin melanoma, consists of an elliptical. fragment of skin measuring 6 x 3 x 0.7 cm. The epidermal surface is brownish,. with an elevated brownish nodularity that measures 1.6 cm in diameter, being. at 0.9 cm from its nearest peripheral margin. On section the lesion presents. a grayish brown color, being homogeneous and smooth. Beneath it tannish,. rubbery tissue, as well as yellowish adipose tissue are observed; the lesion. being at 0.5 cm from the deep margin. Margins inked. Lesion totally submitted. Peripheral margins. (9 cassettes). B) SPECIMEN labeled right axillary sentinel lymph node #1, consists of an irregular. fragment of yellowish adipose tissue measuring 2.5 x 1,6 cm. On section one lymph. node is identified measuring 2.5 X 1.5 cm, presenting a yellowish, homogeneous,. rubbery parenchyma. 2 cassettes ). C) SPECIMEN labeled left axillary sentinel lymph node #2, consists of an irregular. fragment of yellowish adipose tissue measuring 4.5 x 4.3 x 0,6 cm. On section. two lymph nodes are identified, the larger one measuring 2.5 x 2 cm and the. other measuring 1.5 x 1.4 cm, presenting tannish, homogeneous, rubbery paren-. chymas.
